ios.desc:
Give your baby the gift of deep, restful sleep — every night.

CozySleep plays white noise, pink noise, and brown noise to soothe newborns and fussy, colicky babies, and to create the perfect sleep environment for your infant or toddler.

Trusted by parents for nap time, bedtime, and those 3 AM moments.

WHY WHITE NOISE WORKS

Babies spend 9 months surrounded by sounds louder than a vacuum cleaner. The quiet of a bedroom is actually unfamiliar — steady, gentle sound is what feels safe and womb-like. Continuous background noise can soften the startle reflex, mask household interruptions, and help babies stay asleep longer.

CozySleep delivers seamlessly looping audio so the sound never cuts out, never restarts, and never wakes your baby.

SOUNDS YOUR BABY WILL LOVE

• Classic White Noise — the universal soother, perfect for newborns
• Brown Noise — deeper, richer tone; especially calming for fussy babies
• Pink Noise — balanced, soft, even frequencies
• Green Noise — the gentlest mid-range hush, ideal for sensitive sleepers
• Fan & Air Conditioner — familiar household hum for instant calm
• Shhhh Sound — mimics the sounds babies hear in the womb
• Heartbeat & Womb Sound — recreates the comfort of the womb
• Rain & Thunderstorm — rhythmic nature sounds for deep sleep
• Ocean Waves — slow, rolling waves for peaceful nap time
• River & Forest — immersive nature soundscapes
• Hairdryer & Vacuum — surprisingly effective household soothers
• Washing Machine — gentle rumble that babies find deeply calming
• Soft Lullabies & Sleep Songs — gentle melodies for a calm, peaceful bedtime

FEATURES BUILT FOR EXHAUSTED PARENTS

• Seamless looping — no gaps, no startles, no wake-ups
• Background play — works while screen is off
• Timer with fade-out — dims sound slowly so you can sneak out quietly
• Offline mode (Premium) — works without Wi-Fi, even on flights
• Favorites — save your baby's go-to sounds for 3 AM access
• Custom Mixes — layer sounds and set each one's volume
• Night-friendly dark design — no blinding screen during night feeds

HOW TO USE

1. Pick a sound — white noise or fan works for most newborns
2. Set the volume to a gentle, consistent level (around shower volume)
3. Use the timer and fade-out so sound dims naturally as baby sleeps deeper
4. Save your baby's favorite to Favorites for instant access at night
5. Turn on offline mode to use without Wi-Fi on trips or in the car

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I just shipped my second iOS app, CozySleep, a baby sleep sounds app.

I built it because my baby had trouble sleeping

The app includes:
- White noise & fan sounds
- Nature, womb, and gentle motion sounds
- Smart timers with fade-out
- Background playback
- Fully offline support

It’s intentionally simple and focused on what parents actually need at 2am.

I’d love any feedback, especially from parents or fellow indie iOS devs.

App Store link: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6745897667
